title: Fluorescent Caspase-3 Staining to Assess Induction of Apoptosis in A6 Cells
author: Elin Verbrugghe
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8tihwke
materials: Fixation and staining of apoptotic cells: (Work in the dark) - Gently wash the infected cells 2 times with 70% HBSS+ - Fix the infected cells with 0.5 mL of 3% paraformaldehyde for 10 min - Wash 2 times with 70% HBSS+ - Permeabilise with 200 µL of 0.1% trition in 70% HBSS+ on room temperature during 2 min. - Wash 2 times with 70% HBSS+ - Incubate 1 hour with a primary antibody (1/1000): * Anti-caspase-3 antibody produced in rabbit -> Sigma-Aldrich - Wash 3 times with 70% HBSS+ - Incubate for 1 hour with a secondary antibody (1/500): * Alexa Fluor 568 goat anti-rabbit IgG - Wash 3 times with 70% HBSS+ - Incubate with Hoechst for 15 min - Wash 3 times with 70% HBSS+ - Mount the coverslips using ProLongGold antifade mountant - Use fluorescence microscopy to analyse apoptosis

Fixation and staining of apoptotic cells: (Work in the dark) - Gently wash the infected cells 2 times with 70% HBSS+ - Fix the infected cells with 0.5 mL of 3% paraformaldehyde for 10 min - Wash 2 times with 70% HBSS+ - Permeabilise with 200 µL of 0.1% trition in 70% HBSS+ on room temperature during 2 min. - Wash 2 times with 70% HBSS+ - Incubate 1 hour with a primary antibody (1/1000): * Anti-caspase-3 antibody produced in rabbit -> Sigma-Aldrich - Wash 3 times with 70% HBSS+ - Incubate for 1 hour with a secondary antibody (1/500): * Alexa Fluor 568 goat anti-rabbit IgG - Wash 3 times with 70% HBSS+ - Incubate with Hoechst for 15 min - Wash 3 times with 70% HBSS+ - Mount the coverslips using ProLongGold antifade mountant - Use fluorescence microscopy to analyse apoptosis

steps.title: Prepare Cell Medium A
steps.instruction: Mix L15 medium, distilled water, and fetal bovine serum in the proportions 70 % L15 medium, 20 % distilled water, and 10 % fetal bovine serum to obtain Cell Medium A.

steps.title: Prepare Cell Medium B
steps.instruction: Mix L15 medium, distilled water, and fetal bovine serum in the proportions 40 % L15 medium, 55 % distilled water, and 5 % fetal bovine serum to obtain Cell Medium B.

steps.title: Coat Coverslips with Collagen
steps.instruction: Place glass coverslips in a 24‑well tissue‑culture plate, add 200 µL of rat‑tail collagen coating solution to each well, incubate at 37 °C for 2 h, then rinse the coated surface twice with HBSS‑. Use immediately or air‑dry and store at 4 °C for up to one week.

steps.title: Seed A6 Cells onto Coverslips
steps.instruction: Detach A6 cells with trypsin, centrifuge 5 min at 1500 rpm, wash once with 70 % HBSS‑, count cells, centrifuge again 5 min at 1500 rpm, resuspend in Cell Medium A to 10e5 cells / mL, add 1 mL (10e5 cells) to each collagen‑coated well, incubate 2 h at 26 °C with 5 % CO₂, then wash with 70 % HBSS+; cells are now ready for Bd exposure. Include a control well for microscopy monitoring.

steps.title: Infect A6 Cells with Bd Spores
steps.instruction: Isolate Bd zoospores, spin 5 min at 3000 rpm (20 °C), discard supernatant, resuspend in Cell Medium B, count spores, dilute to 10e6 spores / mL in Cell Medium B, add 1 mL of this suspension to each well (MOI = 10:1), incubate 2 h at 20 °C with 5 % CO₂, then wash infected cells three times with 70 % HBSS+ to remove non‑adherent spores. Include a control well to monitor spore motility.

steps.title: Post‑Infection Incubation and Maintenance
steps.instruction: Replace Cell Medium B with Cell Medium A and maintain the cultures for 4–6 days (as required) at 20 °C with 5 % CO₂; note that Bd zoospores lose motility when exposed to Cell Medium A.
